question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is building one platform for sustainability, data and compliance.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: Loose halftone sheets drift in and press together into one stack on a cream chip.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is building one platform for sustainability, data and compliance.

beats.line: Its software helps organisations report climate and supply-chain data.
beats.headline: ESG REPORTING
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the stacked sheets unfold into a document laid over grid paper.
beats.delivery: Its software helps organisations report climate and supply-chain data.

beats.line: Four businesses have been absorbed, including the pivotal Resulticks deal.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the document folds into four small paper buildings; string and pins link them together.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Four businesses have been absorbed, including the pivotal Resulticks deal.

beats.line: That Resulticks acquisition was valued at one point five billion dollars.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the linked buildings collapse into a tall coin stack; a rubber stamp presses down on it.
beats.delivery: [excited] That Resulticks acquisition was valued at one point five billion dollars.

beats.line: Integration across many jurisdictions is the primary risk here.
beats.headline: INTEGRATION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the coin stack flattens into a torn paper map; clips pin its separated pieces.
beats.delivery: Integration across many jurisdictions is the primary risk here.

beats.line: Admin costs rose three point four million, to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the torn map folds upward into a rising paper bar chart; a torn strip marks the top bar.
beats.delivery: Admin costs rose three point four million, to eight point one million.

beats.line: By early September, shares traded at one dollar sixteen.
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart shears into a torn-paper arrow pointing down to a hanging price tag.
beats.delivery: By early September, shares traded at one dollar sixteen.

beats.line: Market capitalisation sits around thirty-four million dollars.
beats.headline: ~$34M CAP
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the price tag shrinks into a single small coin alone on open grid paper.
beats.delivery: Market capitalisation sits around thirty-four million dollars.

beats.line: Diginex has signalled focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar market.
beats.headline: BRAZIL $77B
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the single coin widens into a paper map; a stencilled arrow lands across it.
beats.delivery: Diginex has signalled focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar market.

beats.line: For now, it's a speculative name needing patience and conviction.
beats.headline: SPECULATIVE
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stencilled arrow rolls into a hole-punched tag; a paper hand enters and holds it still.
beats.delivery: For now, it's a speculative name needing patience and conviction.
